title: Safely managed drinking water, LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World
headline: Safely managed drinking water: up 13.0 points in LDCs, 10.6 in LLDCs and 4.0 in SIDS since 2000
subtitle: Proportion of the population using drinking water from an improved source that is accessible on premises, available when needed and free from contamination
years: LDCs: from 25.8% in 2000 to 38.8% in 2024. World: from 61.3% to 73.7%.
data_line: Data: WHO/UNICEF JMP via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_H2O_SAFE, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Safely managed drinking water: up 13.0 points in LDCs, 10.6 in LLDCs and 4.0 in SIDS since 2000. LDCs: from 25.8% in 2000 to 38.8% in 2024. World: from 61.3% to 73.7%. LDCs: 25.8% in 2000 to 38.8% in 2024; LLDCs: 26.3% in 2000 to 36.9% in 2024; SIDS: 53.5% in 2000 to 57.5% in 2024; World: 61.3% in 2000 to 73.7% in 2024
question: What lies behind the change in safely managed drinking water in Least developed countries, and what could others learn from it?
